blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering.
We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance.
Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-action timeline mismatch between imagined and executed action sequences, while recurrent world models such as DreamerV3 can attribute observed transitions to commands that were not actually applied.
Our analysis shows that TD-MPC2 requires the correct future action sequence during latent dynamics rollout, whereas DreamerV3 requires timely attribution of each transition to the action that generated it.
Based on these findings, we introduce two lightweight execution-consistent interfaces, Future-Sequence for TD-MPC2 and Applied-Action Feedback for DreamerV3, that correct these mismatches without modifying the pretrained world models.
Experiments across delays, packet loss, reordering, multiple control domains, measured network traces, and a process-separated asynchronous stack consistently support both diagnoses and the corresponding architecture-specific corrections.
blocks.zh:
世界模型控制器在预测和规划时依赖行动条件的动态,然而由于通信延迟,数据包丢失,重排顺序,以及起动器缓冲等原因,真正的控制系统往往同步执行指令.
我们研究同步执行如何改变在世界模型控制器中假设的动作语义,而不是仅仅将其作为外部控制扰动处理.
通过受控干预,我们识别出两种依赖架构的失败模式:基于规划的控制器如TD-MPC2在被想象出的行动序列和执行的行动序列之间遭遇了未来动作时长不匹配,而像DreamerV3这样的经常性世界模型可以将所观测到的过渡归属于未实际应用的命令.
我们的分析表明,TD-MPC2在潜在动态推出过程中需要正确的未来动作顺序,而DreamerV3则需要及时将每次过渡归于产生它的行动。
基于这些发现,我们引入了两个轻量级执行相容接口,即TD-MPC2的未来-序列和DreamerV3的应用-动作反馈,这些接口在不修改预先训练过的世界模型的情况下纠正了这些错配.
跨越延迟,包丢失,重排,多控制域,被测量到的网络痕迹,以及一个过程相分离的同步堆栈,始终支持诊断和相应的架构特异性校正.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: (a) Synchronous execution keeps commanded and applied actions aligned. Under asynchronous execution, (b) TD-MPC2 suffers from future-action timeline mismatch, while (c) DreamerV3 can suffer from previous-action attribution mismatch.
blocks.zh: 图1: (a) 同步执行保持指挥和应用行动一致。 在同步执行下, (b)TD-MPC2会受未来动作时间错配的影响,而 (c)DreamerV3会受前作动作归属错配的影响.

blocks.en:
World models have become a central paradigm for model-based decision making, enabling agents to predict future outcomes, optimize policies through imagined trajectories, and plan actions online in learned latent dynamics ( Hansen et al., 2022 ; Hafner et al., 2024 ; Hansen et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Anand et al., 2026 ) .
These capabilities are particularly attractive for continuous control and robotics, where the controller must repeatedly predict how actions change the environment before acting ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Brito and McNamee, 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
However, practical control systems are rarely perfectly synchronous: action computation, communication, buffering, and actuation may occur on different timelines ( Zhang et al., 2013 ; Park et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
As a result, the action issued by a controller is not always the action that actually drives the corresponding environment transition ( Katsikopoulos and Engelbrecht, 2003 ; Bouteiller et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh:
世界模型已成为以模型为基础的决策的核心范式,使代理人能够预测未来的结果,通过想象的轨迹优化政策,并在网上规划学习到的潜在动力方面的行动(Hansen等,2022;Hafner等,2024;Hansen等,2024;Li等,2026;Anand等,2026)。
这些能力对于持续控制和机器人特别有吸引力,控制者必须反复预测动作如何在行动前改变环境(Wu等,2023;Brito和McNamee,2025;Li等,2025.).
然而,实际控制系统很少完全同步:动作计算,通信,缓冲和活化可能在不同时间段发生(张等,2013;朴等,2018;王等,2026).
因此,控制器发布的动作并不总是实际推动相应环境过渡的动作(Katsikopoulos和Engelbrecht,2003;Bouteiller等,2021;Chen等,2021).

blocks.en: Prior work on delayed and asynchronous control has followed several directions at different stages of the control loop. Early formulations recover a Markovian decision process by augmenting the state with delayed observations, pending actions, or action histories ( Katsikopoulos and Engelbrecht, 2003 ; Walsh et al., 2009 ; Derman et al., 2023 ) . Later work uses learned dynamics or belief estimation to compensate for delayed interaction by propagating the effects of pending actions, reconstructing the current latent state, or incorporating multi-step action delay into model-based planning ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Kim et al., 2023 ; Valensi et al., 2024 ) . More recent methods address stochastic or unobservable execution timing through delay-corrected learning, adaptive interaction models, or alternative future actions conditioned on uncertain execution times and packet loss ( Bouteiller et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Wikman et al., 2026 ) . In parallel, recent robot-control systems consider the effects of slow policy inference on execution: RTC overlaps action generation with execution while preserving committed actions, REMAC addresses inconsistencies between current perception and concurrently executed action chunks, and FutureRTC predicts the state or observation available when new actions begin execution ( Black et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 先前关于延迟和同步控制的工作在控制循环的不同阶段遵循了几个方向. 早期的配方通过延迟观测、待采取行动或行动历史来恢复马尔科维安的决策进程(Katsikopoulos和Engelbrecht,2003年;Walsh等人,2009年;Derman等人,2023年)。 后一工作利用所学的动态或信念估计,通过宣传待决行动的影响,重建当前潜在状态,或将多步骤行动延迟纳入以模型为基础的规划来弥补延迟的互动(Chen等,2021;Kim等,2023;Valensi等,2024). 较新的方法通过延迟修正的学习、适应性互动模式,或以不确定的执行时间和包丢失为条件的替代未来行动,解决难以观察的执行时间问题(Bouteiller等,2021;Wu等,2024;Wikman等,2026)。 同时,最近的机器人控制系统考虑到缓慢的政策推论对执行的影响: RTC在保留承诺的行动的同时将动作生成与执行相重叠,REMAC处理当前感知与同时被执行的动作块之间的不一致,FutureRTC预测新动作开始执行时的状态或观察(Black等,2025;Wang等,2026;Jiang等,2026).

blocks.en: Execution-semantic gap. World-model control raises a different issue because actions serve both as outputs for execution and as explicit inputs to the learned predictive model. Existing delay-aware model-based methods mainly use learned dynamics to compensate for delayed interaction, while recent studies of asynchronous world models examine related misalignment on the observation side ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Anand et al., 2026 ) . Less well understood is how command–execution mismatch affects the action-conditioned computations inside a world-model controller when the action used by the model differs from the one that generates the corresponding environment transition. This effect depends on the architecture: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC and TD-MPC2 roll future action sequences through learned latent dynamics, whereas recurrent world models such as DreamerV3 condition latent-state updates on previous actions ( Hansen et al., 2022 ; Hansen et al., 2024 ; Hafner et al., 2024 ) . We therefore hypothesize that the same execution mismatch affects these architectures differently, producing a future-action timeline mismatch in planning-based world models and a previous-action attribution mismatch in recurrent world models.
blocks.zh: 执行语义差距. 世界模型控制提出了另一个问题,因为行动既是执行的产出,也是对学到的预测模型的明确投入。 现有的延迟-认知模型基方法主要利用所学的动态来弥补延迟的相互作用,而最近对同步世界模型的研究则研究了观测侧的相关错位(Chen等,2021;Anand等,2026). 不太清楚的是,当模型使用的动作与生成相应环境过渡的动作不同时,命令-执行不匹配会如何影响世界模型控制器内部的动作条件计算. 这种效果取决于架构:基于规划的控制器,如TD-MPC和TD-MPC2通过所学潜在动态来滚动未来动作序列,而诸如DreamerV3条件等反复出现的世界模型,对以往动作进行潜在状态更新(Hansen等,2022;Hansen等,2024;Hafner等,2024). 因此,我们假设,同样的执行不匹配对这些结构的影响不同,在基于规划的世界模型中造成未来行动时间不匹配,在经常性的世界模型中造成先前行动归属不匹配。

blocks.en:
Execution-consistent interfaces. Following latent-space MPC designs that roll candidate action sequences through learned dynamics, our ablations show that current applied-action or buffer information is insufficient for TD-MPC2; reliable planning instead depends on the future action timeline in the dynamics rollout (Figure 3 ).
Inspired by packet-based communication and packetized predictive control in networked control systems, we introduce Execution-Consistent Interfaces (ECI) , a family of architecture-specific interfaces aligning world-model action inputs with actions realized by the execution system.
For planning-based world models, we instantiate ECI as Future-Sequence Execution , which transmits the planner-generated future action suffix to an actuator-side buffer, preserving the action timeline considered during planning.
For recurrent world models, we instantiate ECI as Applied-Action Feedback , which feeds the applied action into the recurrent state update, restoring the correct action–transition correspondence.
Both interfaces modify only the controller–execution interface and leave the pretrained world model unchanged during deployment.
blocks.zh:
执行一致接口. 根据潜在空间的MPC设计,通过学习到的动态来滚动候选动作序列,我们的模拟显示,当前应用动作或缓冲信息不足以用于TD-MPC2;而可靠的规划则取决于动态推出中的未来行动时间表(图3 )。
受网络控制系统基于包的通信和包的预测控制启发,我们引入了"执行相容接口"(ECI),这是一组针对特定架构的接口,将世界模型行动投入与执行系统实现的行动相配合.
对于基于规划的世界模型,我们即时将ECI作为未来-序列执行(Future-Sequence Enterpression),将规划者生成的未来行动后缀传递给一个起动者-侧缓冲器,保留规划中考虑的行动时间表.
对于反复出现的世界模型,我们即时将ECI作为应用行动反馈,将应用行动反馈到经常性状态更新中,恢复正确的行动-过渡通信。
两个接口都只修改控制器-执行接口,在部署时保留被预先训练出的世界模型不变.

blocks.en: Key empirical findings. Our experiments reveal three consistent observations. (1) Command–applied divergence degrades control even with a fixed planned command sequence, and reliable latent planning requires the correct future action timeline inside the dynamics rollout. (2) Effective corrections differ across architectures: planning-based control benefits from preserving an updatable future action sequence, while recurrent control depends on timely action feedback consistent with training. (3) These effects extend across TD-MPC/TD-MPC2, multiple control domains, measured network-delay traces, and a process-separated asynchronous execution stack.
blocks.zh: 关键的经验结论。 我们的实验揭示出三个一致的观测结果. (1) 即使有固定的计划指令序列,命令-应用的分歧也会削弱控制,可靠的潜伏规划需要在动态推出过程中有正确的未来行动时间表。 (2)有效校正因不同架构而异:基于规划的控制从维护可更新的未来行动序列中获益;而经常性的控制则取决于与培训相一致的及时行动反馈. (3)这些效果延伸至TD-MPC/TD-MPC2,多控制域,被测量到的网络延迟痕迹,以及一个过程相分离的同步执行堆.

blocks.en: Contributions .Our main contributions are threefold. (1) We identify execution-semantic mismatch as a failure mode of world-model control and show that it manifests as a future-action timeline mismatch in planning-based TD-MPC2 and as a previous-action attribution mismatch in recurrent DreamerV3. (2) Guided by this diagnosis, we instantiate execution-consistent interfaces that preserve the planner’s future action timeline for TD-MPC2 and feed back the actually applied action for DreamerV3, without modifying the underlying pretrained world models. (3) We validate these mechanisms across controller architectures, control tasks, delay, packet loss and reordering, measured network traces, and a process-separated asynchronous execution stack.
blocks.zh: 捐款 我们的主要贡献有三个。 (1)我们将执行-语义错配确定为世界模式控制的失败模式,并显示它表现为基于规划的TD-MPC2中的未来行动时间错配,以及经常DreamerV3中之前的行动归属错配. (2) 以这种诊断为指导,我们即时执行-一致接口,保留规划者未来的TD-MPC2行动时间表,并反馈DreamerV3实际应用的行动,而无需修改基本的预先训练的世界模型。 (3)我们验证这些跨控制器架构的机制,控制任务,延迟,包丢失和重排,被测量的网络痕迹,以及一个过程分离的同步执行堆栈.

blocks.en: 2 Why Do World-Model Controllers Fail Under Asynchronous Execution?
blocks.zh: 2 为什么要使用世界模型控制器 在同步执行下失败吗 ?

blocks.en: In this section, we conduct a series of controlled empirical analyses to understand why world-model controllers degrade under asynchronous execution. Rather than treating delay, packet loss, or reordering merely as external disturbances, we focus on how these execution effects alter the action information consumed by the world model.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进行了一系列有控制的实证分析,以了解为什么世界模型控制器在同步执行下降解. 我们不是仅仅将延迟、包丢失或重排顺序视为外部干扰,而是侧重于这些执行效应如何改变世界模型所消耗的行动信息。

blocks.en: 2.1 Finding 1: Planning-Based World Models Need the Correct Future Action Timeline
blocks.zh: 2.1 调查结果1:基于规划的世界模式 需要正确的未来行动时间表

blocks.en: Figure 2: Effect of execution delay under fixed commands. Error bars denote 95% confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 固定命令下执行延迟的影响。 出错栏表示95%的置信间隔.

blocks.en: We first isolate asynchronous execution from planner behavior by replaying the same planned command sequence from matched environment states while changing only the action-delivery delay. Figure 2 shows that greater delay increases command–applied divergence and reduces short-horizon return, even though the planner makes the same decisions. Thus, the execution process itself can degrade control, suggesting that TD-MPC2 may be missing information about how its commands will actually be realized.
blocks.zh: 我们首先将同步执行从规划者的行为中分离出来,从匹配的环境状态重放相同的计划指令序列,同时只改变动作-交付延迟. 图2显示,尽管规划者作出同样的决定,但更大的延迟会增加指令-应用差异并减少短视回报。 因此,执行过程本身可以降解控制,说明TD-MPC2可能缺少关于其命令将如何实际实现的信息.

blocks.en: To identify this missing information, we progressively provide TD-MPC2 with the current applied action, the actuator buffer, or the exact future applied-action sequence. The first two describe only the current execution state, whereas the last specifies the action timeline that will actually drive the environment.
blocks.zh: 为了识别这一缺失的信息,我们逐渐向TD-MPC2提供当前应用动作,起动器缓冲器,或者确切的未来应用动作序列. 前两个只描述当前执行状态,而后两个则指定了实际驱动环境的行动时间表.

blocks.en: Figure 3: TD-MPC2 execution-information ablations. Left: information type across perturbations. Right: insertion point. Brackets and error bars denote 95% CIs.
blocks.zh: 图3:TD-MPC2执行-信息模拟。 左:横跨扰动的信息类型. 右:插入点. 括号和出错条表示95%的CI.

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows that current applied-action or buffer information is insufficient, while the exact future sequence improves control only when it enters the latent dynamics rollout; using the same information for trajectory rescoring alone provides no benefit. This identifies the failure more precisely: TD-MPC2 predicts future states under one action sequence, while asynchronous execution may realize another. We refer to this as a future-action timeline mismatch . Reliable planning therefore requires the action timeline used inside the world-model rollout to remain consistent with the one realized by the execution system.
blocks.zh: 图3显示,目前的应用行动或缓冲信息不足,而准确的未来序列只有在进入潜在动态推出时才能改善控制;仅使用同样的信息进行轨迹再评就没有任何好处。 这更准确地识别出故障:TD-MPC2预测了在一个动作序列下的未来状态,而同步执行可能实现另一个状态. 我们称之为未来行动时间不匹配。 因此,可靠的规划要求在世界模式推出过程中使用的行动时间表与执行系统实现的时间表保持一致。

blocks.en: 2.2 Finding 2: Execution-Semantic Mismatch Manifests Differently across World-Model Architectures

blocks.en: We next ask whether execution-semantic mismatch also appears in world-model architectures that consume actions differently. Unlike TD-MPC2, which uses future actions during latent rollout, DreamerV3 conditions its recurrent state update on the previous action and the new observation. Under asynchronous execution, the environment may evolve under one applied action while the recurrent model attributes the transition to a different issued command.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来要问的是,执行-语义上的不匹配是否也出现在以不同方式消耗动作的世界模式架构中. DreamerV3 与 TD-MPC2 不同,后者在潜在推出时使用未来动作,为它关于前作和新观察的反复状态更新提供了条件. 在同步执行下,环境可能在一个应用动作下会演化出,而反复出现的模型则将过渡归属于不同的已发布的指令.

blocks.en: Figure 4: DreamerV3 feedback alignment under random delay.
blocks.zh: 图4:在随机延迟下进行DreamerV3反馈对接.

blocks.en: To isolate this effect, we vary only the previous-action input to DreamerV3’s recurrent update while holding the observed trajectory and forecast action fixed. We evaluate both command-trained and applied-action-trained checkpoints, allowing us to test whether the benefit of applied-action feedback depends on the action semantics learned during training.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离这种效果,我们只将先前的动作输入更改为DreamerV3的反复更新,同时将观测到的轨迹和预测动作固定. 我们评价经过指挥训练的检查站和经过应用行动训练的检查站,使我们能够检验应用行动反馈的好处是否取决于训练期间学到的行动语义。

blocks.en: Figure 4 links prediction and control: the left panel reports prediction-error reduction, while the right reports return change with 95% CIs. Applied-action feedback improves both measures for applied-action-trained checkpoints, but is not uniformly beneficial for command-trained models. This indicates that the recurrent-state update is sensitive not only to which action is supplied, but also to the action semantics learned during training. Together with Finding 1, this reveals two distinct failure modes: a future-action timeline mismatch in TD-MPC2 and a previous-action attribution mismatch in DreamerV3. Execution corrections should therefore target where each architecture consumes action information and remain consistent with its learned action semantics.
blocks.zh: 图4链接了预测和控制:左侧面板报告预测-误差减少,而右侧报告则以95%的CI回落. 应用行动反馈改进了对应用行动训练的检查站采取的措施,但并非都有利于指挥训练模式。 这表明,经常状态更新不仅对提供何种行动具有敏感性,而且对培训期间学到的动作语义也具有敏感性。 与"发现1"一起揭示出两种截然不同的失败模式:TD-MPC2中的未来动作时段不匹配和DreamerV3中之前的动作归属不匹配. 因此,执行更正应针对每个架构使用行动信息的地方,并与其学到的动作语义保持一致。

blocks.en: Execution-consistent planning. The proposed interface does not predict future communication delays or introduce an additional control policy. Instead, it preserves future control information that TD-MPC2 has already produced. When a newly replanned command is unavailable, the actuator continues along the remaining actions of the newest available plan rather than immediately switching to an unrelated fallback action. This reduces the discrepancy between the future action sequence evaluated during world-model rollout and the sequence available for execution, directly addressing the future action timeline mismatch identified in Finding 1.

blocks.en: Execution receipt. To obtain the applied action without accessing simulator-internal information, the actuator returns an execution receipt together with the subsequent observation. The receipt identifies which action generated the transition, including its source packet and its position within that packet. It can either carry the applied-action vector directly or provide an identifier that allows the controller to recover the corresponding action from its local command history. Because the receipt is piggybacked on the observation, no additional communication round trip is required.
blocks.zh: 执行收据。 要在不访问模拟器-内部信息的情况下获得所应用的动作,操作者会与后续的观察一起返回执行收据. 收据中确定了哪些行动产生了过渡,包括其源包及其在该包中的位置。 它可以直接携带应用动作向量,也可以提供标识符,使控制器从其本地指令历史中恢复相应的动作. 由于收据被附在观察后,不需要额外的通信往返.

blocks.en: Correct action attribution. The purpose of this interface is not to provide DreamerV3 with future execution information, but to ensure that each observed transition is paired with the action that actually produced it. When the execution receipt arrives in time, the RSSM can update its recurrent state using the correct action, directly addressing the previous action attribution mismatch identified in Finding 2. The intervention changes only the information exchanged between the controller and the execution system, while leaving the pretrained world model and actor unchanged.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We study two structurally different world-model controllers, TD-MPC2 and DreamerV3. Unless explicitly studying delay-aware retraining, all pretrained models remain frozen during evaluation. We consider clean execution, fixed and random action delays, packet loss, and packet reordering, and further validate selected settings using measured network-delay traces and a process-separated asynchronous execution stack.
blocks.zh: 我们研究两个结构不同的世界模型控制器,即TD-MPC2和DreamerV3. 除非明确研究延迟意识再培训,否则在评估期间,所有经过培训的模型仍然被冻结。 我们考虑干净的执行、固定和随机的动作延迟、包丢失和包重排,并使用测量的网络延后跟踪和进程分离的同步执行堆栈进一步验证选定的设置。

blocks.en: Our primary experiments use the DeepMind Control Suite ( Tassa et al., 2018 ) : TD-MPC2 is evaluated on Dog, Walker, and Hopper, while DreamerV3 is evaluated on Walker, Cheetah, and Cup. Cross-domain experiments further cover MetaWorld ( Yu et al., 2020 ) , ManiSkill2 ( Gu et al., 2023 ) , and MyoSuite ( Caggiano et al., 2022 ) . We report performance using three key metrics: episodic return for overall control performance, task success rate for tasks with explicit completion criteria, and command–applied action divergence for quantifying execution-semantic mismatch. Deployment-oriented experiments additionally report per-step execution overhead and communication statistics. Primary results are reported with 95% confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要实验使用DeepMind Control Suite(Tassa等,2018年) :TD-MPC2在Dog,Walker和Hopper上被评价,而DreamerV3在Walker,Cheetah和Cup上被评价. Cross-domain实验进一步覆盖了MetaWorld(Yu等,2020年),ManiSkill2. (Gu等,2023年),和MyoSuite (Caggiano等,2022年). 我们使用三个关键衡量标准来报告业绩:总体控制业绩的零星回报率、有明确完成标准的任务任务成功率、以及用于量化执行-语义不匹配的指令-应用行动差异。 面向部署的实验还报告逐步执行间接费用和通信统计。 报告的主要结果有95%的置信间隔。

blocks.en: For TD-MPC2, we compare four execution-side baselines: Single-Action sends only the current planned action; Hold-Last repeats the most recently available action when a new command is unavailable; Fixed Chunk transmits and executes a fixed multi-action chunk; and Receding Buffer maintains a buffered action sequence that is refreshed as new plans arrive. Our method, Future-Sequence , preserves the planner-generated future action sequence at the execution side, while a privileged Future-Action Oracle uses future applied actions only for diagnosis. We also compare with delay-aware learning methods, DATS ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and ACDA ( Wikman et al., 2026 ) , which adapt the controller during delayed training. For DreamerV3, CMD conditions the recurrent update on the issued command, RCP repeatedly executes the current command, and our APP instead feeds back the actually applied action. ECT-Full and ECT-ID implement APP in the process-separated stack using actuator-originated execution receipts.

blocks.en: Table 3.2 and Figure 6 summarize the main results on frozen TD-MPC2 and DreamerV3 controllers. For TD-MPC2, Future-Sequence preserves clean performance, substantially improves robustness across all adverse execution conditions, and achieves the highest reported adverse-condition average among the TD-MPC2 execution interfaces excluding the Oracle. It outperforms Single-Action, Hold-Last, and Fixed Chunk across all reported perturbations, matches Receding Buffer at the reported precision under random delay, bursty delay, and reordering, and achieves higher return under packet loss. For DreamerV3, Applied-Action Feedback provides the clearest gains under random delay, packet loss, and reordering, whereas Repeated Command offers little consistent benefit and fixed-delay improvements are less uniform. Together, these results support architecture-specific execution corrections: preserving the planner-generated future action sequence for planning-based world models, and correcting action attribution for recurrent world models. Additional numerical comparisons for DreamerV3 are provided in Appendix A . Figure 9 visualizes the difference within a paired Walker-Walk rollout under packet reordering. Both methods use the same checkpoint, initial state, environment seed, and transport seed. Single-Action loses balance early and attains a return of 397.4, whereas Future-Sequence remains upright throughout the episode and reaches 889.2. The replayed frames and body-height traces show how preserving a coherent future action sequence turns the aggregate return gain into sustained physical stability.
blocks.zh: 表3.2和图6总结了被冻结的TD-MPC2和DreamerV3控制器的主要结果. 就TD-MPC2而言,未来序列保持了干净的性能,大大改善了所有不利执行条件的稳健性,并在不包括甲骨文的TD-MPC2执行接口中实现了报告的最高不利条件平均值. 它在所有报告的扰动中都超过了单行动、持住和固定春克,在随机延迟、突起延迟和重排下与报告的精确度匹配,并在包损失下实现更高的回报。 对DreamerV3来说,应用行动反馈在随机延迟、包丢失和重排方面提供了最明显的收益,而重复命令则没有什么一致的好处,固定延迟改进不太统一。 这些成果共同支持针对特定架构的执行纠正:为基于规划的世界模型保留规划者产生的未来行动序列,并纠正重复出现的世界模型的行动归属。 DreamerV3的其他数字比较见附录A。 图9可视化了组合的Walker-Walk在包重排下推出的相差. 这两种方法都使用相同的检查站,初始状态,环境种子,以及运输种子. 单一行动及早失去平衡,回报397.4分,而未来序列在整个剧集中始终保持正率并达到889.2分. 重放的帧和身高痕迹显示,保持一个连贯的未来行动序列如何将总收益转化为持续的物理稳定性。

blocks.en: We further test Future-Sequence beyond the primary TD-MPC2 setting. It produces consistent gains on the original TD-MPC controller, across held-out MetaWorld, ManiSkill2, and MyoSuite tasks, and under measured network-delay profiles. These results show that the benefit is not restricted to TD-MPC2, a single task domain, or synthetically generated delay.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步测试超越初级TD-MPC2设定的未来顺序。 它在最初的TD-MPC控制器上产生一致的收益,跨越被搁置的MetaWorld,ManiSkill2和MyoSuite任务,并在被测量的网络延迟配置下产生一致的收益. 这些结果表明,好处并不局限于TD-MPC2,一个单一的任务域,或者合成产生的延迟.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows that the corrections remain effective when the controller and actuator run in separate processes communicating over UDP. Under injected delay, loss, and reordering, Future-Sequence recovers TD-MPC2 performance across the evaluated conditions, while Applied-Action Feedback improves DreamerV3 in most conditions. The required action feedback can be supplied directly by the actuator: ECT-Full returns the applied-action vector, whereas ECT-ID identifies its source packet and position. Both recover the exact applied action across 30,000 tested transitions, demonstrating that action attribution can be implemented through execution receipts rather than privileged simulator access.
blocks.zh: 图7显示,当控制器和开动器通过UDP以不同的流程运行时,更正仍然有效。 在被注入的延迟,损失和重排下,"未来-序列"恢复了TD-MPC2在被评价条件下的性能,而"Application-Action回馈"则在大多数条件下改进了DreamerV3. 所需的动作反馈可由起动器直接提供: ECT-Full返回应用动作向量,而ECT-ID则确定其源包和位置. 两者都收回在30,000个经过测试的过渡中精确应用的动作,表明动作归属可以通过执行收据而不是特权模拟访问来实现.

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析

blocks.en: A natural question is whether Future-Sequence remains useful when the controller is already trained under delayed execution. Table 2 reveals a strong interaction. Clean-trained checkpoints benefit broadly, whereas combining Future-Sequence with Fixed-2 training degrades every adverse condition. Random-delay training is mixed: it improves stochastic delay, loss, and reordering but degrades fixed-delay conditions, leaving the adverse average nearly unchanged. This pattern shows that delay-aware training and execution-side correction are not automatically additive. The most plausible explanation is that delay-aware training changes the implicit action semantics of the controller, so an execution interface designed for a clean-trained controller can become mismatched or compensate twice. Absolute returns are reported in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 一个自然的问题是,当控制器已经在被延迟执行下训练时,未来序列是否仍然有用. 表2显示了强有力的相互作用。 受过清洁训练的检查站普遍受益,而将未来序列与固定2型训练相结合则会降低每一种不利条件。 随机延迟训练有好有坏:它改进了斯多克延迟、损失和重排顺序,但降解了固定的延迟条件,使不利的平均值几乎保持不变。 这种模式表明,延迟感知培训和执行方修正并非自动添加. 最有道理的解释是,延迟-意识训练会改变控制器所隐含的动作语义,因此为清洁-训练控制器所设计的执行接口会变成不匹配或两次补偿. 附录B报告了绝对返回情况。

blocks.en: Figure 8 examines how feedback timeliness affects Applied-Action Feedback. At both evaluated control rates, immediate feedback yields the highest aggregate return, while one- and two-period feedback delays progressively reduce performance. Thus, access to applied actions alone is not sufficient: their temporal correspondence with the observed transitions also matters. This complements the action-semantics analysis in Section 2.2 , identifying timely, transition-aligned feedback as an important requirement for effective recurrent-state correction.
blocks.zh: 图8审查了反馈及时性如何影响应用行动反馈。 在两个评价的控制率中,即时反馈的总回报率最高,而一和两期反馈延迟则逐渐降低业绩。 因此,仅仅利用所应用的行动是不够的:它们与所观察到的过渡之间的时间联系也很重要。 这补充了第2.2节中的行动语义分析,确定及时、与过渡相协调的反馈是有效的经常状态纠正的重要要求。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: 5.1 Delayed reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh: 5.1 延迟强化学习。

blocks.en: Delayed reinforcement learning studies decision making when observations or actions are delayed. Methods fall into three categories. The first augments state with pending actions or action histories to recover the Markov property ( Walsh et al., 2009 ; Derman et al., 2023 ) . The second exploits delayed dynamics through state prediction or model-based reasoning, including real-time actor–critic, delay-aware model-based reinforcement learning, and belief-projection methods ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Kim et al., 2023 ) . The third addresses stochastic or partially observable delays through delay-corrected learning, latent planning, or adaptive interaction models ( Bouteiller et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Valensi et al., 2024 ; Wikman et al., 2026 ) . Overall, this work progressed from representing delayed interactions to inferring decision-relevant states and actions under uncertain execution timing. Its primary objective is effective decision making under delay, not understanding how execution timing alters action-conditioned computations within a world-model controller.
blocks.zh: 在观察或行动被推迟时,延迟加强学习研究的决策。 方法分为三类。 第一种情况是,为追回马尔可夫财产采取了未决行动或行动历史(Walsh等人,2009年;Derman等人,2023年)。 第二种则通过状态预测或模型推理来利用延迟动态,包括实时演员-批评,延迟-认知模型的强化学习,以及信仰-预测方法(Chen等,2021;Kim等,2023). 第三点涉及通过延迟修正的学习、潜在规划或适应性互动模型而出现的扭曲或部分可观察到的延误(Bouteiller等,2021;Wu等,2024;Valensi等,2024;Wikman等,2026)。 总的来讲,这项工作从代表延迟的互动发展到推断与决策有关的国家和执行时间不确定的行动。 其主要目标是延迟有效决策,而不是理解执行时间如何改变世界模型控制器内的行动条件计算。

blocks.en: 5.2 World-model control under asynchronous execution.
blocks.zh: 5.2 同步执行下的世界模型控制.

blocks.en: World-model controllers use action-conditioned dynamics for prediction, policy optimization, and planning, including recurrent latent models such as PlaNet and Dreamer ( Hafner et al., 2024 ) , tree-search methods including MuZero and EfficientZero ( Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ; Ye et al., 2021 ) , and latent trajectory optimization in TD-MPC and TD-MPC2 ( Hansen et al., 2022 ; Hansen et al., 2024 ) . World models handle delayed interaction via future-state prediction, delayed-observation imagination, and delay-aware planning ( Wikman et al., 2026 ) . These works mainly use world models to compensate for delay rather than study how asynchronous execution can invalidate assumed action semantics. Recent robot-learning methods emphasize prediction–execution alignment: RTC supports asynchronous action-chunk generation and execution, REMAC addresses inconsistencies between perception and concurrent actions, and FutureRTC studies prediction–execution misalignment ( Black et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) ; related work studies asynchronous sensor observations in world models ( Anand et al., 2026 ) . We therefore study the action side of world-model control under asynchronous execution and show how command–applied divergence induces future-action timeline mismatch in planning-based models and previous-action attribution mismatch in recurrent models.
blocks.zh: 世界模型控制器在预测、政策优化和规划中使用了具有行动条件的动态,包括PlaNet和Dreamer(Hafner等,2024年)等经常出现的潜在模型,以及树上搜索方法,包括MuZero和OfficientZero(Schrittwieser等,2000年)。 2020; Ye等, 2021),以及TD-MPC和TD-MPC2中的潜在轨迹优化(Hansen等,2022;Hansen等,2024). 世界模型通过未来状态预测,延迟观察想象和延迟意识规划处理延迟相互作用(Wikman等,2026. 这些作品主要使用世界模型来补偿延迟,而不是研究同步执行如何能够使假设的动作语义无效. 最近的机器人学习方法强调预测-执行相接:RTC支持同步动作-充子生成与执行,REMAC解决感知与并发行动之间的不一致,未来RTC研究预测-执行相接错(Black等,2025;Wang等,2026;Jiang等,2026;相关工作研究世界模型中的同步传感器观测(Anand等,2026). 因此,我们研究在同步执行下世界模型控制的行动方面,并表明指令-应用差异如何诱发基于规划的模型中的未来行动时间不匹配以及经常模型中先前的行动归属不匹配。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we identify how asynchronous execution disrupts action-conditioned computation in world-model controllers. Controlled interventions reveal a future-action timeline mismatch in TD-MPC2 and a training-dependent previous-action attribution mismatch in DreamerV3. Guided by these findings, execution-consistent interfaces improve control across tasks and asynchronous execution conditions. Our results highlight the importance of aligning execution-time action information with both model computation and learned action semantics.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们确定同步执行是如何扰乱世界模型控制器中动作条件计算. 受控干预显示,TD-MPC2中的未来行动时间表不匹配,DreamerV3中的培训依赖前行动归属不匹配. 在这些发现的指导下,与执行相协调的接口改进了跨任务的控制和同步执行条件. 我们的成果突出了将执行时间动作信息与模型计算和所学动作语义一致的重要性。

blocks.en: Appendix D Baseline Definitions
blocks.zh: 附录D 基线定义

blocks.en: Single-Action transmits only the first planned action. Hold-Last reuses the most recently available action when no new command arrives. Fixed Chunk accepts a new action sequence only after its active queue is exhausted. Receding Buffer accepts newer plans, discards actions whose scheduled execution times have passed, and replaces the remaining queue; after exhaustion, it holds the last applied action. Our Future-Sequence interface stores actions according to their intended execution slots, updates overlapping future slots when newer plans arrive, and rejects stale plans. The registered diagnostic implementation uses a zero-action fallback when no valid planned action remains.
blocks.zh: 单项行动只传达第一个计划的行动。 当没有新的命令到来时, Hold- Last 重新使用最近可用的动作 。 固定春克只有在其活动队列被耗尽后才能接受新的动作序列. 卸下缓冲器接受较新的计划,放弃预定执行时间已过的行动,并替换所剩队列;在耗尽后,它持有最后应用的动作. 我们的"未来-序列"接口会根据预定的执行档次存储动作,在更新计划到来时更新重叠的未来档次,并拒绝过时的计划. 登记在案的诊断实施采用零行动退缩,因为没有有效的计划行动。

blocks.en: The Future-Action Oracle evaluates candidate actions using an isolated copy of the network and actuator state, including future packet-delivery outcomes. The resulting applied-action sequence is then supplied to the world-model rollout. This Oracle is a privileged diagnostic condition rather than a deployable interface or a guaranteed upper bound on return.
blocks.zh: " 未来行动甲骨文 " 利用网络和激活状态的单独副本评价候选行动,包括未来的数据包交付结果。 由此产生的应用动作序列随后提供给世界模式推出. 这个甲骨文是一个特殊的诊断条件,而不是一个可部署的接口或返回时有保证的上限.

blocks.en: Command Feedback ( CMD ) supplies the issued command to the recurrent update. Repeated Command ( RCP ) transmits five copies of the current command rather than a predicted future action sequence. Our Applied-Action Feedback ( APP ) instead supplies the actual previous action. In the process-separated implementation, ECT-Full returns the applied-action vector, whereas ECT-ID returns its source packet and position, allowing the controller to reconstruct the action from its command history.
blocks.zh: 命令回馈(CMD)向经常性更新提供发布的命令. 重复指令 (RCP) 转发了5份当前指令,而不是一个预测的未来动作序列. 我们的应用行动反馈则提供了先前的实际行动。 在进程分离的执行中,ECT-Full返回应用程序动作向量,而ECT-ID返回其源包和位置,使控制器能够从其命令历史中重建动作.

blocks.en: D.1 External Learning-Based Baselines
blocks.zh: D.1 外部学习基线

blocks.en: We reproduce DATS ( Chen et al., 2021 ) using an ensemble of five probabilistic dynamics models, each with four hidden layers of width 200. The models predict transition means and variances and are trained with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , batch size 256, and five epochs per update. Planning uses CEM with horizon 30, 500 candidates, 50 elites, and five optimization iterations. Following DATS, pending actions are prepended to each candidate suffix so that planning accounts for actions already committed to execution. Training uses a fixed two-step action delay. For Walker, we use the analytic task reward; for Dog and Hopper, the learned model additionally predicts the observed reward.
blocks.zh: 我们使用由5个概率动态模型组成的组合来复制DATS(Chen等,2021年),每个模型有4个隐藏层的宽度200. 这些模型预测了过渡手段和差异,并经过培训,每次更新的学习率为10-3-10-X-3},批量大小为256个,以及五个时代。 规划使用CEM,拥有地平线30,500名候选者,50名精英,并有5个优化迭代. 继DATS之后,将为每个候选人的后缀准备待决行动,以便规划已承诺执行的行动。 培训使用固定的两步动作延迟。 对Walker来说,我们使用分析任务奖励;对Dog和Hopper来说,学习模型额外预测了观察到的奖励.

blocks.en: We adapt the released ACDA implementation ( Wikman et al., 2026 ) to the DMC task interface and our runtime. ACDA uses a delay-indexed action matrix with horizon four, policy hidden layers of width 256, predictive-model hidden and recurrent dimensions of 256 and 384, and a model window of 16. The batch size is 256, replay capacity is 10 6 10^{6} , and the predictive-model learning rate is 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Delay memorization and model-output clamping are enabled. At execution time, ACDA produces its native delay-conditioned action matrix rather than a TD-MPC2 future sequence.
blocks.zh: 我们将发布的ACDA执行(Wikman等,2026年)适应DMC任务界面和我们的运行时间. ACDA使用延后索引动作矩阵,具有地平线4,政策隐藏层宽度为256,预测模型隐藏和重复维度为256和384,模型窗口为16. 批量大小为256个,回放容量为10 6 10^{6},预测-模型学习率为10−4 10^{4}. 启用了延迟记忆和模型输出夹克。 在执行时,ACDA生成其原生的有延迟条件的动作矩阵,而不是一个TD-MPC2未来序列.

blocks.en: DATS and ACDA train their own predictive models and controllers, whereas our Future-Sequence interface operates on a pretrained TD-MPC2 controller without modifying its parameters. We therefore evaluate each method as its complete controller–execution system. Checkpoints remain fixed during evaluation, and stochastic evaluations use ten environment seeds per checkpoint and condition with 500 control decisions per episode.
blocks.zh: DATS和ACDA训练自己的预测模型和控制器,而我们的"未来-序列"接口则在事先训练的TD-MPC2控制器上运行而无需修改其参数. 因此,我们评价每一种方法都是其完整的控制器-执行系统。 在评价期间,检查站仍然固定不变,而且抽查评价每个检查站和条件使用10个环境种子,每集有500个控制决定。
